newsitem.title: INDIA: INDIA STATE OFFICES TO CLOSE EARLY ON THURSDAY.
newsitem.headline: INDIA STATE OFFICES TO CLOSE EARLY ON THURSDAY.

text.p: Indian federal government offices in New Delhi will close early on Thursday in honour of the 50th anniversary of independence, the government said on Wednesday.
A government statement said offices in North Block and South Block were scheduled to close at 1 p.m. (0730 GMT).

Offices in Rail Bhawan, Vayu Bhawan, Udyog Bhawan, National Archives of India, Krishi Bhawan, Shastri Bhawan, Nirman Bhawan, Vigyan Bhawan and the Indira Gandhi National Centre for Arts will close at 3 p.m. (0930 GMT), the statement said.
All of the offices are situated near the Raj Path boulevard, where a "March of the Nation" involving thousands of people is scheduled to take place from 9 p.m. (1530 GMT) on Thursday.
The march will end near Vijay Chowk (Victory Square), near the North Block and South Block. Laser shows and firework displays are scheduled to be held at the spot.
India's parliament will hold a special session at midnight August 14-15 to commemorate independence won on August 15, 1947.
